[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Today marks: a 🍅 on task lines that are on today's plan[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every open #task line whose task is on today's plan (it has a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]dedicated Task Link under one of today's open Pomodoros) shows a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]display-only 🍅 Today mark right after its identity glyph. The mark[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]appears in Live Preview, and in rendered views wherever the line's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]identity is exact. Its tooltip names the Pomodoro and whether it is[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]running or queued. Mod+click and a keyboard command jump to the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Task Link, and a session toggle hides every mark. The mark is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]truthful or neutral: it never guesses, never goes stale, and is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never written.[/#D7D7AF]
